questions.stem_text:
Suppose that the total value of all transactions in the United States is $100,000 and the
money supply is $10,000. Calculate the velocity of money.

An increase in corporate optimism will have which of the following effects in the market
for loanable funds?

options.A: A decrease in both supply and demand and an ambiguous change in interest rates.
options.B: An increase in supply lowering the interest rate.
options.C: A decrease in demand increasing the interest rate.
options.D: An increase in demand increasing the interest rate.
options.E: A decrease in supply increasing the interest rate.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - An increase in demand increasing the interest rate.

questions.stem_text: If firms that make a particular product expect its price will be lower in the future

options.A: this will cause the supply of the product to decrease right now.
options.B: this will have no effect on the amount of the product supplied right now.
options.C: this will have no effect on the supply of the product now or later.
options.D: this will cause the supply of the product to increase right now.
options.E: this will cause the supply of the product to decrease in the future.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - this will cause the supply of the product to increase right now.
